description: Schema for the master literature-review table of the PINN dossier. One JSON file per paper in data/rows/. Every field is filled ONLY from the paper's own text; use empty string when the paper does not state it. Numbers verbatim with units.

fields.name: paper_id
fields.desc: inventory ID, e.g. PINN-A01 (given, do not change)

fields.name: title
fields.desc: exact title from the PDF

fields.name: authors_full
fields.desc: all authors as printed, comma-separated

fields.name: affiliations
fields.desc: institutions + countries of the authors

fields.name: year
fields.desc: publication year

fields.name: venue
fields.desc: journal / conference name as printed

fields.name: venue_type
fields.desc: journal | conference | preprint | webpage

fields.name: identifier
fields.desc: DOI or arXiv id

fields.name: pdf_path
fields.desc: local path of the analyzed PDF (or empty if abstract-only)

fields.name: pdf_pages
fields.desc: number of pages in the PDF

fields.name: citations_approx
fields.desc: from inventory (given); leave as given

fields.name: verification
fields.desc: from inventory (given); leave as given

fields.name: primary_category
fields.desc: foundational-theory | architecture | operator-learning | domain-application | benchmark | framework | review

fields.name: domain_group
fields.desc: Fluids & aerospace | Thermal | Energy & power | Batteries | Nuclear | Climate & weather | Renewables | Biomed & healthcare | Geoscience | Civil & structural | Materials & mfg | Finance | Methods & training | Meta-review

fields.name: subdomain
fields.desc: specific application area, e.g. transonic airfoil, battery SOH

fields.name: industry_context
fields.desc: which industry/sector this serves and any named company/lab (NASA, DLR, Siemens...)

fields.name: problem_class
fields.desc: forward | inverse | both | operator | control/optimization | forecasting | UQ | theory | survey | benchmark

fields.name: trl_evidence_level
fields.desc: math-benchmark | simulation | experimental-lab-data | real-system-pilot | deployment-report | n-a

fields.name: physics_enforced_exact
fields.desc: the exact governing equations/laws enforced (names + form: e.g. incompressible Navier-Stokes: momentum + continuity, 2D) - copy the paper's own description

fields.name: pde_type
fields.desc: elliptic | parabolic | hyperbolic | mixed | ODE/DAE | integral/variational | multiple

fields.name: dimensionality
fields.desc: e.g. 1D, 2D, 2D+time, 3D, high-dim (state count for ODEs)

fields.name: nonlinearity
fields.desc: linear | mildly nonlinear | strongly nonlinear (justification)

fields.name: bcs_ic_handled
fields.desc: which boundary/initial/auxiliary conditions are imposed and how

fields.name: enforcement_mechanism
fields.desc: soft-penalty | hard-constraint | weak/variational | energy-form | operator | hybrid (+1-line why)

fields.name: enforcement_details
fields.desc: exactly HOW physics enters training: autodiff residual of which operator, projection layer, output transform, divergence-free construction, variational form, conservative layer, etc.

fields.name: network_architecture
fields.desc: MLP depth/width if stated, or DeepONet/FNO/transformer/KAN etc., any modifications

fields.name: activation_function
fields.desc: tanh | sin (SIREN) | swish | ...

fields.name: input_representation
fields.desc: network inputs: (x,t), extra features (distance function, parameters, sensor embeddings...)

fields.name: output_representation
fields.desc: network outputs: fields, fluxes, parameters; any transforms applied to outputs

fields.name: loss_terms
fields.desc: every term in the loss with notation, e.g. L = L_data + lambda_r L_pde + lambda_b L_bc

fields.name: loss_weighting
fields.desc: fixed | annealed | NTK-based | gradient-norm | self-adaptive attention | causal weights | (values if given)

fields.name: sampling_strategy
fields.desc: collocation point generation: uniform/random/adaptive RAD/RAR/residual-refinement, counts if given

fields.name: optimizer_schedule
fields.desc: Adam then L-BFGS, epochs/iterations, two-stage/curriculum, learning rates if given

fields.name: training_compute
fields.desc: hardware + training time if stated

fields.name: domain_decomposition
fields.desc: if any: subdomain count, interface treatment (cPINN/XPINN/FBPINN...)

fields.name: transfer_or_pretraining
fields.desc: transfer learning / pretraining / meta-learning used, from what

fields.name: uq_method
fields.desc: uncertainty quantification if any (Bayesian, ensembles, posterior...)

fields.name: data_regime
fields.desc: physics-only (no data) | sparse sensors | dense simulation | experimental; counts/geometry of data points

fields.name: datasets_used
fields.desc: named datasets/benchmarks/cases solved

fields.name: baselines_compared
fields.desc: FEM/FVM/FDM, other PINN variants, DeepONet/FNO, experimental measurements...

fields.name: evaluation_metrics
fields.desc: relative L2 error, RMSE, MAE, R^2, runtime, ...

fields.name: key_quantitative_results
fields.desc: the main numbers with units and case names (2-5 bullets worth of facts)

fields.name: errors_reported
fields.desc: specific error values per case, e.g. rel-L2 = 3.2e-3 on Burgers

fields.name: speedup_claims
fields.desc: any speedup/efficiency claims vs baselines, with conditions

fields.name: ablations
fields.desc: ablation studies performed and what they showed

fields.name: stated_limitations
fields.desc: limitations the authors themselves state (with section/page if locatable)

fields.name: failure_modes
fields.desc: failure/instability/training issues discussed (even if in related-work)

fields.name: reproducibility
fields.desc: code/data URL, framework used, seeds, config availability

fields.name: quotable_finding
fields.desc: one verbatim sentence (<=30 words) worth quoting in our survey, with page number

fields.name: relevance_rqs
fields.desc: which of RQ1 (industries/problem classes) / RQ2 (components) / RQ3 (physics+mechanism) / RQ4 (reviews+reliability) this paper evidences, with a phrase each

fields.name: manuscript_section
fields.desc: which planned section/table of our AIR manuscript it feeds (S4 methods, S5 domain applications, T1-T3, F2-F6)

fields.name: reading_priority
fields.desc: 1-5 from inventory (given); adjust ±1 only if full text justifies

fields.name: cross_paper_links
fields.desc: builds-on / compares-to / contradicts: other inventory IDs or named papers

fields.name: notes_caveats
fields.desc: your analyst notes: overclaims, weak evaluation, only-1D, toy cases, etc.

fields.name: analysis_confidence
fields.desc: full-paper | partial (some sections unreadable/absent) | abstract-only (no PDF)

fields.name: analysis_date
fields.desc: YYYY-MM-DD of this analysis
